originalProtocol.primaryRamMetric: maximum memory.peak across all replay workers in one fresh cgroup
originalProtocol.boundary: offline service container including coordinator, Node, SQLite/native memory, filesystem cache and fixture state; excludes host OS, Docker daemon, live curl and production supervision
originalProtocol.repeatProtocol: Sequential fresh offline containers; one virtual replay and three independent full wall replays per population; no overlapping benchmark runs; no forced GC; retain failures. Bootstrap reconciles seeded history once, followed by three unchanged samples.
originalProtocol.fairProgressTarget: Every recipient first delivery by complete classification time + two global-rate sweeps (announcement and first listing) + retryAfterMs + latencyMs, with capacityDrainTolerance
